Name: Hatmann's Strange Weapon Collection
Author: MrHatmann
Description:
A variety of strange and poorly balanced weaponry added to the Adventurer's Guild Shop.

This collection of weapons was gathered and sold to Marlon at a premium by an individual known only as Hatmann.
Are they useful?
Are they balanced?
Who knows. Or cares?

In all seriousness, this is just a collection of silly weapons I made for my friends and I when we play Stardew. I balanced them to be as close to base game weapon prices as I could, with a few advantages here and there. I don't really plan to spend much time getting these in perfect balance, but I'll probably add some new stuff as time goes on.

Mainly a series of references to various games we like and a few references to the YouTuber, Captain Southbird.
Check him out here: https://www.youtube.com/c/CaptainSouthbird/

This was made using JSON Assets and requires it to work. You can find it here:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720

Bugs or feedback is appreciated, I will get to it when I can.
